description: This grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across various language families. The horizontal category axis is labeled "family" and displays the discrete categories IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, arranged from left to right. The vertical value axis is labeled "effect" and features a linear scale with numeric tick marks at 0, 10, 20, and 30, representing an interval of 10, with the visual range extending slightly below 0 and above 30 to accommodate error bars. Within each language family category, there is a group of six adjacent bars. According to the legend, these bars represent different models and metrics, distinguished by color: mBERT-L₂ (light blue-grey), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). The bar heights vary significantly across the categories; the shortest bars dip slightly below zero, such as the mBERT-R₂ bar in the Semitic group at approximately -2, while the tallest bars are found in the IE-Indic group, where the mBERT-B₂ bar reaches approximately 24. Categories such as Isolate and Uralic feature bars that all remain close to 0, whereas groups like IE-Germanic, IE-Slavic, and Semitic show pronounced differences between the L₂, R₂, and B₂ metrics. All bars are visually emphasized with a thin black outline and include vertical error bars with caps. The chart is set against a dark grey background with horizontal grid lines corresponding to the major tick marks on the vertical axis.
